title: POST /game-api/s2s-api/v1.0/lobby/rooms/register
$comment: Observed on 1.8.0.13 in the same three runs as dedicatedServers/registerUnmanagedServer, immediately after it: 200, 702-706 bytes. This is the call that puts the server in the browser and produces the Direct Join Code. Note what the body carries: the owner token as accessToken, the whole room configuration, and game.password in clear.

dedicatedHostId.description: The dedicatedServerId from the registration answer.

accessToken.description: The owner token, replayed. The owner token is the lobby session credential.

sessionId.description: A per-run session id, 21 characters in the captures. The room answer returns the same value.

scenarioName.description: A localization key, not a display name. Observed: #AR-Campaign_ScenarioName_Everon.

hostAddress.description: The address the backend hands to clients. It is the same string that comes back in mpRoom.hostAddress, so whatever is wrong here is wrong for every player.

invisible.description: The inverse of game.visible: the captures had visible:false and invisible:true.

joinQueueMaxSize.description: 0 in the captures. A queue a joining client sees is therefore not this room's queue.

flags.description: 0 in the captures; its meaning was not established.

password.description: game.password, sent to the backend in clear. **Absent when no password is set** - the run with an empty game.password has no password key at all. Anything that logs or publishes this body publishes the server password.

autoJoinable.description: Present only in that same run, where it is true: the captured bodies show either a password and no autoJoinable, or no password and autoJoinable:true. The exact rule was not established, but it is the field the answer's dsConfig.game.autoJoinable echoes.

admins.description: game.admins. Empty in the captures. The backend warns on it: `!!! JsonApi Array name="admins" ... items will be skipped!` because the receiving class does not declare it.

roomId.description: Equal to providerServerId from the registration answer and to the serverId inside the owner token.

hostType.description: CommunityDs for a self-hosted server - the string behind the CommunitySelfHosted serverType in the owner token. The enum lists what was observed; the binary also carries OFFICIAL, COMMUNITY and SINGLE_PLAYER in its EServerType.

directJoinCode.description: The 10-digit code the server logs as `Direct Join Code:` and a player can join with directly.

pingSiteId.description: `unknown` in every capture - the server logs it as `Ping Site: unknown`.

runtimeStats.description: Empty in the captures; the per-room stats the browser can show.
